newsitem.title: SOMALIA: At least six killed in fighting in south Mogadishu.
newsitem.headline: At least six killed in fighting in south Mogadishu.

text.p: At least six people were killed and 10 wounded in south Mogadishu in renewed fighting between two rival factions, hospital sources said on Wednesday.

The factions, led by Hussein Mohamed Aideed and Osman Hassan Ali Atto, battled for three hours on Tuesday night, using infantry militiamen and "technical vehicles" -- pickup trucks mounted with heavy machineguns, they said.

Aideed, son of the late Somali leader Mohamed Farah Aideed, met Atto in Yemen two days ago after mediation by Yemeni President Ali Abdullah Saleh. They have been fighting on and off since they fell out in 1995.
Witnesses said three of the dead were militiamen. The identities of the others were not immediately available.
